prompts.rice_basket: Transparent isolated game artwork, Korean Joseon minhwa ink and muted watercolor style. A broad shallow woven bamboo basket heaped with many distinct ivory, pale pink, pale green and golden Korean songpyeon honey rice cakes. Front three-quarter view, basket and rice together form ONE contiguous compact silhouette suitable for freely cutting into paper pieces in a game. Thick clear ink outlines, hand-painted traditional texture matching an ochre folk tiger and ink mountain collage. Wide low basket, no handles, no person, no scenery, no text, no floor or shadow. Center entire basket with generous clear transparent margins. Real transparent background.
prompts.tiger_eat: Transparent game animation sheet of a Korean Joseon minhwa tiger eating a rice cake WHILE AIRBORNE, facing RIGHT. EXACTLY THREE complete full-body sequential frames in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW, three equal square cells on 1536x512 canvas. Same tiger: ochre-orange, black ink stripes, cream muzzle, whimsical fierce face, delicate traditional brush texture. Frame1 forepaws hold small ivory rice cake by open mouth midair, frame2 bites and chews with paws tucked and tail curled, frame3 swallows contentedly while turning into a diving leap to retreat. All four paws and entire tail visible in each cell. Identical body scale and center, each pose entirely within its own 512x512 cell with at least 45 pixels of empty transparent padding on EVERY side. No grid lines, no lettering, no other objects, no landscape, no floor, NO shadows or glow. Genuine transparent background, do not overlap frames.
prompts.siblings_climb: Use case: illustration-story. Transparent isolated game sprite. Reference1 defines the exact player's appearance: Korean male traveler, wide straw hat, sage-gray green long hanbok coat, ivory pants, dark waist belt, straw shoes, short black hair/faint beard. Reference2 defines younger sister: black side braid, sage-green jeogori and cream long skirt. Draw BOTH characters climbing an INVISIBLE vertical heavenly rope, player ABOVE and smaller younger sister DIRECTLY BELOW him, both facing right in three-quarter profile, arms raised gripping the same vertical center line, knees bent climbing. Keep a small gap between the player's feet and sister's raised hands. Full bodies, complete hat and all hands/feet visible. No rope drawn because game draws it separately. Muted Korean minhwa ink/watercolor, match references' clothing and faces. Tall portrait canvas, generous transparent margins, no scenery, no text, no shadows or glow. One single combined composition, not an animation sheet.
